findings.finding: Structured Art and source-static history, including final #125 specialist-supported nomination, were hidden by the initial detail renderer.
findings.resolution: Renderer now shows frozen Art recommendation, historical portrait Art/source-static review, material replay and historical native separately; #125 finalisation note remains explicit.

findings.finding: Policy descendants displayed the original parent source without a parent qualifier or policy-intent limitation.
findings.resolution: Detail now labels original parent and separate descendant custody, preserves Setup digest, states invalid original intent is not proved equivalent, and identifies #183 outside Gold25.

findings.finding: Frozen comparison sites and coordinate windows were bundled but inaccessible from comparison UI.
findings.resolution: Comparison view exposes named source site buttons, coordinates and full-resolution archived material images; gameplay remains explicitly independent sequential Worlds.

findings.finding: Archived A/B/C crops could be misattributed because their randomized neutral labels were not translated for owner review.
findings.resolution: Exact card.variants mapping now appears above site links and inside the detailed image window; D1/D2 retain different randomized orders.

findings.finding: Decision guide called Gold an original-only exemplar even though nominated #207 is a repaired portrait baseline.
findings.resolution: Guide now describes baseline exemplar nomination and explicitly permits an earlier repair as baseline; #207 keeps repaired portrait role and original parent.

findings.finding: Ordinary Workbench replacement buttons could replace the active evaluation World without the collection lifecycle warning or a new source identity. Specialist C identified the initial New/Load gap.
findings.resolution: Seven exact accepted-engine replacement captions now route to Save/return/Cancel, including lazy Mixed Actor Workshop. Source inspection confirms direct initial ui.load_setup remains unchanged and the lazy panel is beneath the scoped Workbench node.

findings.finding: Filename polling and close-time registration could attribute a different source saved file to the current map merely because its label was typed without Save.
findings.resolution: Both blind registration paths are removed. Receipts follow true ui.save_setup success through protected new-name saving; ordinary Save button and Ctrl+S retain the accepted field-commit and Paint Editor eligibility behavior.

findings.finding: Flatten/Bake History could create an engine binary MaterialBaseline save that the collection JSON saved-copy reader could not reopen.
findings.resolution: The unsupported transition now displays an explicit non-mutating limitation before any bake. Ordinary painting, Undo, Play, Restore start and new named JSON saves remain supported. Binary saved-copy support is not claimed.

findings.finding: Case-sensitive reserved save-name checks allowed an uppercase GM-SOURCE label to alias a later source staging filename on Windows.
findings.resolution: All saved-copy admission, Save, receipt registration and browser-copy boundaries case-fold the reserved prefix. The actual session fixture checks uppercase refusal, absent receipt and unchanged bytes.
